_note: Every line in the game (M8; DESIGN.md 'Dialogue system'): family talk, radio calls, creatures and cutscene captions. Fields: id; speaker (config.story.speakers); channel 'radio' (a call while Tom's out), 'face' (said in the room; heard as a radio call when Tom's away) or 'caption'; text ({name} fills in from the caller); when { night: [min, max], phase: [...], all: [flags], none: [flags] }; priority (higher first); on (an event that plays it); next (the line that follows it); repeatable (never marked heard; dropped, not queued, if the radio's busy); kind (the radio's rate-limit kind); urgent (cuts the radio's queue, with the alarm pips); script (plays from its trigger only while that script is live: config.story.liveScripts); cue (where the line will be triggered, for the session that wires it); cued (M9.2: played only by the system named in its cue, never picked by talking to the family); draft (M9.2: written by the session for Aaron to edit). New lines are written with each encounter, with Aaron (Session 11).

lines.cue: Opening, Tom wakes (the cutscene opening.wake plays it)
lines.speaker: ellen
lines.text: Tom. Wake up. Something's happened at the facility. I tried my old lab line, nothing. Every channel's static except the emergency band.

lines.cue: Opening, end: played as the waking cutscene ends, skipped or not (Session 16, Aaron: the player must not miss it)
lines.speaker: ellen
lines.text: I need eyes on the woods. Go outside and climb the tower, Tom. Tell me what you see out there.

lines.cue: The tower's view: the red light blinking far to the south (day1.tower; Session 16, Aaron: someone has to address it)
lines.speaker: wyatt
lines.text: Dad, you see that red light? Way out south. It keeps blinking.

lines.cue: After Wyatt, the red light (day1.tower; Session 16, Aaron: what the civilians were told)
lines.speaker: ellen
lines.text: That'll be the military. They've been out past the facility for weeks. A training exercise, they told everyone. I worked there long enough to know better.

lines.cue: Top of the tower (the cutscene day1.tower plays it)
lines.speaker: wyatt
lines.text: Dad, there's a car down at the campground. Those campers checked in two days ago. They never checked out.

lines.cue: After line 3
lines.speaker: junie
lines.text: Their fire's out. I saw the smoke over the trees last night, from my window. It's gone now.

lines.cue: Campsite sweep (sweep.campsite plays it)

lines.text: Their car's still there, Dad. Check the tents. Maybe somebody made it.

lines.text: Play it, Tom. Whatever they saw, I need to know.

lines.cue: After the clip (Campsite)
lines.speaker: ellen
lines.text: That wasn't an animal. I've heard things like that before, on the recordings. Please be careful.

lines.cue: Shotgun picked up, wave starts (Campsite)
lines.speaker: wyatt
lines.text: Dad, behind you! In the trees!

lines.cue: Wave cleared (Campsite)
lines.speaker: wyatt
lines.text: They didn't stop when you hit them. They just kept coming until they couldn't.

lines.cue: After line 9
lines.speaker: ellen

lines.cue: After line 13

lines.cue: Dusk 1 forecast
lines.speaker: ellen
lines.text: This is how we stay alive. Left side is what we've got: fence, doors, charge. Right side is what's coming. Keep the left side bigger.

lines.cue: Night 1, after line 20; then the night fades to dawn (FirstDay; Session 15b)

lines.text: And if their phone's still working, we can call for help.

lines.cue: Night 1, all nine down, before camera six (FirstDay; Session 15b)

lines.text: That's all of them. The fence held, Dad.

lines.text: Tom, camera six. Look at this.

lines.cue: During the clip (clip.night1)
lines.speaker: ellen
lines.text: She's burying something. The transmissions talked about marks like that, wherever the dead started rising.

lines.cue: Clip ends (clip.night1)

lines.cue: Dawn 1, either way

lines.cue: Day 1: the battery's fitted and Tom's outside (FirstDay; draft): brings him in to meet the family
lines.speaker: junie
lines.text: Dad? Can you come inside for a minute?

lines.cue: Arriving at the gas station (sweep.gasStation; Session 15b)
lines.speaker: wyatt
lines.text: No lights on. Dad, their truck's gone. Maybe they got out.

lines.cue: The gas station's mutant is down (GasStation; Session 15b)
lines.speaker: ellen
lines.text: Tom? Tom, what was that? That wasn't like the others.

lines.cue: Tom tries the gas station's phone: dead (GasStation; Session 15b)

lines.cue: Earl's note on the office desk, read (GasStation; Session 15b: Aaron kept my draft)

lines.text: Marcy, I've taken the kids to the shelter. If you find this, come straight there. Do NOT go to the military checkpoint, they don't know what they're dealing with. That witch has been burying things in the woods for weeks. Rifle's in the safe, but she's empty, never found the right rounds. Combination's on my keys. E.

lines.text: ...all civilians inside the quarantine line are to remain indoors. Do not approach the checkpoint. Repeat, do not approach the che...

lines.cue: After the scanner (GasStation; Session 15b)

lines.cue: After the witch at the gas station (gas.witch; Session 15b). Session 17 (Aaron: one idea at a time): the phone is its own line now, gas.phone.hint
lines.speaker: ellen

lines.speaker: ellen
lines.text: Take your shovel out to that shelter, Tom. If she's been burying things for weeks, we need to dig them up.

lines.cue: Arriving at the storm shelter (sweep.shelter; Session 16)
lines.speaker: wyatt
lines.text: Earl hid it well, Dad. Didn't matter. Look at them, all over the hatch.

lines.cue: The first of the dead climbing out of the shelter's sigil (StormShelter; Session 16)
lines.speaker: ellen

lines.cue: The shelter's sigil dug up, after the dead were seen climbing out of it (StormShelter; Session 16, Aaron)
lines.speaker: wyatt

lines.cue: The shelter's sigil dug up before any were seen climbing out (StormShelter; Session 16)

lines.text: That glow's gone, Dad. Whatever that thing was, it's dead now.

lines.cue: After Wyatt, the shelter's sigil dug up (StormShelter; Session 16, Aaron: the sigils must be causing the zombies)

lines.cue: After Wyatt, Earl's keys taken (StormShelter; Session 16)

lines.cue: Tom's first time down into the shelter's room (StormShelter; Session 16)
lines.speaker: junie
lines.text: Dad? Are Earl's kids down there?

lines.cue: After Junie, Tom's first time down (StormShelter; Session 16, Aaron: maybe they escaped)

lines.cue: Earl's diary put down, in the shelter (StormShelter; Session 16)
lines.speaker: ellen
lines.text: He saw her coming for months, Tom. Bring that diary home.

lines.cue: Earl's tapes taken, in the shelter (StormShelter; Session 16)
lines.speaker: wyatt
lines.text: Tapes from his trail cams? Bring them home, Dad. If his cameras caught her, I want to see.

lines.cue: Earl's tape at the comms room: the Pruitts come into frame (clip.pruittTape; Session 16; DESIGN: Wyatt reacts first)
lines.speaker: wyatt
lines.text: That's them. That's Earl and his kids. Dad, she's right there. She's right on top of the hatch.

lines.cue: Earl's tape: after they scatter (clip.pruittTape; Session 16; DESIGN: Ellen explains)
lines.speaker: ellen
lines.text: He was filming her for months, on his own, with nothing but trail cams. Everything I've pieced together from the inside, he saw it with his own eyes.

lines.cue: Earl's tape: the empty clearing (clip.pruittTape; Session 16; DESIGN: Junie catches what they missed; Aaron: maybe the kids escaped)
lines.speaker: junie
lines.text: The kids ran the other way. Into the trees. She went after their dad. Maybe they got away.

lines.cue: Earl's tape: the last seconds, the glow by the hatch (clip.pruittTape; Session 16)
lines.speaker: wyatt
lines.text: And that glow, by the hatch. That's the thing you dug up, Dad. That's how they got them.
